Visibility Shortcut Acceptance Criteria
nodes.rationale: A shortcut is accepted only when its raster supercover is unblocked and its integrated cost does not exceed the replaced subpath, preserving endpoint and route measurements.

Provenance Classification Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: The labels distinguish a fixture's origin from the behavior a test proves, because a real source does not by itself establish a verified end-to-end transformation.

nodes.label: Cross-System Provenance Gap
nodes.rationale: The JSON fixture cannot prove Java's KMZ-to-JSON transformation because no KMZ upload-to-optimisation cycle produced and retained the compared payload and supporting evidence.

nodes.label: Non-Round-Trip Provenance Limit
nodes.rationale: The generated corpus is synthetic and Python-contract verified, so it must not be described as real-source or round-trip verified data.
